'''April 2001 Holt tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Daggetts Comics, Holt, Michigan on 22 April 2001. [[Andrew Ehret]] won it. It is known from Andrew Ehret's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2147">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-24-holt-michigan-4-22-2001d2147/ holt-michigan-4-22-2001], DeckTech (Andrew "Gwaihir" Ehret, 24 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-24-holt-michigan-4-22-2001d2147/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Daggetts Comics, Holt, Michigan
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 18
* '''Winner:''' [[Andrew Ehret]]
